title: Preparation of Defined Medium for Marine Holozoans
author: Sebastián R. Najle
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wydffs6

steps.title: Prepare Stock Solution A (Trace Elements)
steps.instruction: Dissolve the following components in dH2O to a final volume of 1 liter: Na2EDTA • 2H2O (4.36 g), FeCl3 • 6H2O (3.15 g), MnCl2 • 4H2O (178.1 mg), ZnSO4 • 7H2O (23 mg), CoCl2 • 6H2O (11.9 mg), CuSO4 • 5H2O (2.5 mg), Na2MoO4 • 2H2O (19.9 mg), H2SeO3 (1.29 mg), NiSO4 • 6H2O (2.63 mg), Na3VO4 (1.84 mg), and K2CrO4 (1.94 mg).

substeps.instruction: Sterilize by filtration through a 0.2 µm filter.

steps.title: Prepare Stock Solution B (Vitamins)
steps.instruction: Dissolve the following components in dH2O to a final volume of 1 liter: thiamine • HCl (vit. B1) (200 mg), biotin (vit. H) (1 mg), and cyanocobalamin (vit. B12) (1 mg).

substeps.instruction: Optional: Prepare primary stock solutions of biotin (100 mg/L) and cyanocobalamin (1 g/L), then use 10 ml of biotin and 1 ml of cyanocobalamin to prepare 1 liter of Stock Solution B.

steps.title: Prepare Stock Solution C (Phosphate)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 5 g of NaH2PO4 • H2O in 1 liter of dH2O.

substeps.instruction: Sterilize by filtration through a 0.2 µm filter.

steps.title: Prepare Defined Medium
steps.instruction: Prepare the final medium by combining salts, glucose, and stock solutions.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 35 g of marine salts (Instant Ocean) and 10 g of glucose in 900 ml of dH2O.
Add 1 ml of Stock solution A (trace elements).
Add 40 µl of Stock solution B (vitamins).
Add 1 ml of Stock solution C (phosphate).
Bring to a final volume of 1 liter with dH2O.
Sterilize by filtration through a 0.2 µm filter.

steps.title: Optional Nitrogen Supplementation
steps.instruction: If the study is not focused on nitrogen metabolism, supplement the medium with 75 mg per liter of NaNO3 or NH4NO3.
